title: precheck warns of a check whose only test stubs the function the goal changes
goal: precheck SP warns of a committed item whose checks run only tests that replace the function its goal changes (a monkeypatch or assignment of that name), since such a check passes when the change reverts; found in SP-7ff7c5ui: BG-4flop3jv and BG-chs2di4p added scenario_pack's check route and FRESH_CHECK inside a test that replaced scenario_pack wholesale, so no suite test could fail on a revert until BG-4lxb2w34

run:
import subprocess, sys, tempfile, os, re
tool = os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py")
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
def run(*a, prog=None):
    return subprocess.run(prog or [sys.executable, tool, "--root", root, *a], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
run(prog=["git", "init", "-q"])
run(prog=["git", "config", "user.email", "a@example.com"])
run(prog=["git", "config", "user.name", "n"])
os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, "_tools"))
open(os.path.join(root, "_tools", "test_a.py"), "w").write(
    "import mod\n\ndef test_stubbed_pack(monkeypatch):\n    monkeypatch.setattr(mod, 'scenario_pack', lambda *a: 1)\n    assert mod.scenario_pack() == 1\n")
open(os.path.join(root, "_tools", "mod.py"), "w").write("def scenario_pack():\n    return 0\n")
run(prog=["git", "add", "-A"])
run(prog=["git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "init", "--no-verify"])
sp = run("new", "sprint", "--title", "S", "--goal", "g").stdout.split()[2]
sid = run("new", "story", "--title", "T", "--goal", "scenario_pack gets a check route", "--touch", "_tools/mod.py",
          "--sprint", sp, "--check", "python3 _tools/tests.py -k stubbed_pack").stdout.split()[2]
p = run("precheck", sp)
out = p.stdout + p.stderr
hit = [l for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith("warning:") and sid in l and "scenario_pack" in l
       and re.search(r"stub|replace|monkeypatch", l, re.I)]
sys.exit(0 if hit else 1)
